listing.name: Metal Gear Solid — Midnight Ghost Stone (coccofresco)
listing.summary: Experimental project. The project marks alpha.1 as UNTESTED for gameplay and platform compatibility. Most logic uses static MIPS-to-native translation with selected adapted decompiled routines. A continuous playthrough has not been confirmed. Preserve Codec saves and backups. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own MetalGearSolid USA SLUS-00594 and SLUS-00776 BIN/CUE discs; retain original data at runtime. Optional own retail BIOS versus bundled OpenBIOS follows primary setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the experimental alpha.1 Linux or Windows archive, or follow the documented source build with your own USA discs. These releases have not been confirmed to complete the campaign or work across the stated platforms.

warnings: The project marks alpha.1 as UNTESTED for gameplay and platform compatibility. Most logic uses static MIPS-to-native translation with selected adapted decompiled routines. A continuous playthrough has not been confirmed. Preserve Codec saves and backups.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
